vb_textbox.text: I dont think there was a 'system' to this game as such, it seemed to be more about luck really. However, I did feel like the 'k' gnome yielded more mushrooms, and there were more zero's on the 's' gnome.The game does go on a bit and its funny because you will find that you forget which button to press at times! But, overall, its a cute game and I hope you enjoy it! Good luck xxx
